projects.name: Deferred-Execution Attacks
projects.description: Defined a new attack class where LLM agents schedule harmful actions to fire after session monitoring ends, then built a trigger-graph monitor that closed the detection gap from 0/4 to 4/4. 1st place at Uncommon Hacks 2026.

projects.name: HypoGeniC vs HypotheSAEs

projects.name: Prediction Market Microstructure
